name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 15, après le point c - Am 37
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ca) Calls for dedicated and reinforced resources within the EU4Health Programme to safeguard the mental health and well-being of young people and university students; insists that a guaranteed share of funding be earmarked to support the creation and deployment of a public, free, and easily accessible psychological, psychotherapeutic, and psychosocial support network across educational institutions and universities, counteracting the profound impact of job precariousness, social isolation, and anxiety, with priority given to underserved and geographically disadvantaged regions;
